options.sleight_of_hand: Make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check to pick a lock, disarm a trap with Thieves' Tools, or pick a pocket.
options.use_an_object: Take the Utilize action, or take the Magic action to use a magic item that requires it.

benefits.climber: You gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed.
benefits.jumper: You can use Dexterity instead of Strength when determining jump distance.

cunning_strike_option.name: Stealth Attack
cunning_strike_option.effect: If you have the Invisible condition from the Hide action, this attack does not end it if your turn ends behind Three-Quarters Cover or Total Cover.

benefits.attunement: You can attune to up to four magic items at once.
benefits.charges: When using a magic item property that expends charges, roll 1d6; on a 6, you expend no charges.

scrolls.cantrips_and_level_1: You cast them reliably using Intelligence as your spellcasting ability.
scrolls.higher_level_spells: Make an Intelligence (Arcana) check, DC = 10 + spell level. Success: cast spell. Failure: scroll disintegrates.

17.name: Thief's Reflexes
17.effect: You take two turns during the first round of combat. First at your Initiative, second at Initiative − 10.
